headline: Impairment drives GAAP loss even as core margins expand
summary_short: Bruker's Q2 2026 revenue grew 5.2% y/y to $838.5M as a $134.9M non-cash goodwill impairment drove a GAAP diluted loss of $(0.41) per share, while non-GAAP diluted EPS rose to $0.49 from $0.32.
summary_long: Q2 revenue grew 5.2% y/y to $838.5M (2.8% organic, 3.4% excluding tariff refunds), led by 10% organic Scientific Instruments bookings growth and 11.9% BEST segment growth, while US academic demand stayed soft. GAAP results swung to an operating loss of $(65.3)M and diluted EPS of $(0.41) on a $134.9M non-cash goodwill impairment plus preferred dividends; non-GAAP operating margin expanded to 14.1% from 9.0% and non-GAAP diluted EPS rose to $0.49 from $0.32. Cash was $184.9M against $1,824.8M long-term debt. Bruker updated FY2026 guidance for currency and tax only: revenue of $3.54-3.57B (3-4% reported growth, 1-2% organic), with non-GAAP EPS held at $2.10-2.15 under an updated 27.5% effective tax rate.
